channel.title: Mastery in Motion by Marcus Lefton
channel.description: Practical ideas to think clearly, perform well, and build with intention.

item.title: Founder time management: why your best work keeps getting displaced
item.description: A practical calendar review for founders whose best hours go to approvals and rescue work. Match your capacity to the work that moves the business.

item.title: How to think clearly under pressure: find what is driving the reaction
item.description: A practical way to separate facts, assumptions, and the demands of a decision when pressure narrows your view. From Marcus Lefton’s Mastery in Motion.

item.title: The founder bottleneck: when your ability to cope hides the problem
item.description: When decisions and rescue work keep returning to the founder, better effort can hide a weak system. Find the dependence and test one change.
